stem: In 1979 the Shah of Iran was forced into exile. The U.S. government later allowed the Shah to enter the United States for medical treatment. This perceived U.S. support for the Shah of Iran resulted in which of the following?

options.label: F
options.text: Iran attacked a U.S. military base in Asia.

options.label: G
options.text: Soviet forces began an occupation of Iran.

options.label: H
options.text: Israel demanded U.S. support for the strategic bombing of cities in Iran.

options.label: J
options.text: Revolutionaries kidnapped a group of U.S. citizens in Iran.
